title: PipeRoll - Agent Incident Registry
description: Verified public records of AI-agent failures: what the agent controlled, what went wrong, what it cost, and what the evidence is. Each release archives the full registry: incident records, schema, index, and machine-readable exports (registry.json, registry.csv). Records are individually verified against primary sources before registration; ids are permanent and never reused; corrections are published in the record. Records and data: CC BY 4.0. Tooling: MIT. Live registry: https://piperoll.org
